# Organizing with Alex

> Founder-led professional home organizing based in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, serving Palm Beach County, Broward and Miami-Dade. Founded and run by Alex Rusinek, a former elementary school teacher.

- Services: closet organizing, pantry and kitchen organizing, move-in unpacking, garage organizing, kids' rooms and playrooms, snowbird and seasonal home care, recurring maintenance plans.
- Pricing: from $100/hour (one organizer) or $130/hour (two organizers); Monthly Refresh $600/month; Seasonal Reset about $1,000/visit; custom projects quoted after a free consultation.
- Areas: Palm Beach Gardens, Jupiter, North Palm Beach, Palm Beach, West Palm Beach, Wellington, Delray Beach, Boca Raton, Miami.
- Contact: call or text (516) 639-7928, organizingwithalex@gmail.com, https://organizingwithalex.com/contact
